shortDescription: According to Wallstreetcn, China's State Administration for Market Regulation and the Standardization Administration approved a mandatory national standard for the external dimensions, axle load, and mass limits of automobiles, trailers, and automobile trains, effective July 1, 2027.

title: China Approves New Mandatory Vehicle Size and Weight Standard Effective July 1, 2027
